issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-21: bond interest line to debt service interest; warrant line detail_category debt principal as in SID 584] The same 31,654 appears on p2 as 'Bond interest' (Total governmental funds column), and no bond principal was paid. The line is all interest, so 'debt service interest' / 'debt interest and fees' fits better.

issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-21: bond interest line to debt service interest; warrant line detail_category debt principal as in SID 584] This is an object line (warrant principal + interest = 1,349,094 + 230,799 on p2), not a function total with no breakdown. issues.on_page: Accrued interest on warrants - Due after one year 10,539
issues.issue: The 'accrued liabilities' category is meant for amounts due soon. This one is due after one year, so 'other liabilities' or 'debt - due in more than one year' may fit better. Judgment call.

The 'utilities' function is meant for water/sewer/electric utility operations. An SID General Fund utilities object line is probably street lighting (streets/highways). The line already carries a review flag.
